title: Carried-check and recognition paths scan the whole launcher argv for --detach, including test-command words after --
outcome: Carried-check and recognition paths scan the whole launcher argv for --detach, including test-command words after --
acceptance: Every host path that decides whether a test-launcher run is detached reads --detach only from the launcher's own options: the words after the mode and before the first `--`, or to the end of the line when there is no `--`.
Behaviour tests show a full and a focused run whose test-command words after `--` contain `--detach` treated as non-detached, and a run with the launcher's own --detach still treated as detached.

completion.summary: Limit detach detection to launcher options before the command separator in both carried-check disposition and test command recognition. The Windows focused regressions and full gate passed, and independent post-landing acceptance passed both criteria.
